links.outcome: Effect of fairness-aware loss on subgroup parity and overall model performance across architectures
links.effect: Fairness constraints enhanced parity across most transformer architectures but degraded hierarchical model performance and caused one clinical model to collapse toward majority predictions.
links.quote: Fairness constraints enhance parity across most transformer architectures, but degrade hierarchical model performance and cause one clinical model to collapse toward majority predictions, demonstrating that fairness interventions are highly model dependent.

links.outcome: Model performance across race, sex, age, and intersectional subgroups
links.effect: Persistent disparities across race, sex, and age remained in subgroup audits despite high overall macro F1 (98.4% for hierarchical CNN).
links.quote: Persistent disparities across race, sex, and age indicate that inequities reflect architectural limitations and systemic biases.

unlisted_practices: Active learning framework to guide annotation of race labels from clinical text
Selecting model architectures aligned with clinical text structure to promote fairness

screen.reason: Evaluates the impact of integrating a fairness-aware loss function on NLP models predicting race from clinical text, comparing performance and demographic parity across models with and without the fairness intervention.
